references.text: The same principle that sin is made known to the sinner, leading to an offering being brought.
A parallel provision for bringing a female animal (a lamb) as a sin offering, also described as without defect.
Further instructions regarding a sin offering with a female from the small livestock (sheep or goat) for unintentional sins.
The provision that a person who sins unintentionally shall bring a one-year-old goat as a sin offering.
The requirement that the sacrificial animal must be without defect (תָּמִים) applies to all offerings to the Lord.
General requirements that sacrificial animals must be without defect to be accepted by the Lord.
The New Testament explains how Christ's blood cleanses from sin, in contrast to the blood of goats and calves.
